Invented v1 review responses shaped against https://judge.me/api/docs, checked 11 October 2026. All identifiers, reviewer details, addresses and review text are fabricated. Reviewer and IP fields exist only to prove the client drops them before persistence or rendering. No token fixtures; tests generate credentials in memory. The API reports moderation with curated (ok, spam, not-yet) and hidden; there is no documented published or country field.
